class_counts.comment: Heuristic triage over the 590 retained_bounded rows not handled separately (595 total minus the 5 in-flight rows). Per-row class is reviewer-owned; the heuristic is deliberately conservative toward genuine because over-converting a bounded row is the dangerous error.

selection_rule: Already audited-clean retained_bounded rows with large transitive descendant counts whose load-bearing content is exact local algebra, finite representation theory, a closed-form identity, existence-uniqueness, an onset coefficient, or an operator realization, and whose safe positive scope is strictly narrower than any still-open physical closure. Rows already converted by the 2026-05-22 promotion queue and the 2026-05-23 bounded-to-retained queue are excluded (they are no longer retained_bounded). The five rows in flight in a separate review packet are excluded.

targets.audit_question: Can the exact finite-shell Schur-complement DtN boundary-action identities at R=4 be reclassified as positive_theorem while leaving the general Einstein/Regge, nonlinear-GR, all-R, and arbitrary-source closures out of scope?
